title: A quiet break
brief: Cowboy smoking a cigarette, just hanging out. A quiet 15-second observation in three shots. This is a proposed starting storyboard for review.
look: Candid Western photography. An adult cowboy in a faded blue work shirt, brown felt hat, worn jeans and scuffed brown boots. A modest ranch porch, weathered wood, soft late-afternoon side light, faded earth colors, restrained contrast and subtle grain. Natural anatomy and ordinary, lived-in details.
continuity: Same adult cowboy, blue shirt, brown hat, chair and ranch porch throughout. Cigarette remains in his right hand. Match the direction of light and his screen position. Maintain the chair, doorway and fence layout between shots. These appearance choices are provisional until selected and reviewed.

references.title: Smoking Cowboy · candid gesture
references.notes: Visually reviewed: loose standing posture, hands at/in pockets, cigarette at mouth, off-camera gaze, warm monochrome and grain. Description says Mardi Gras 2005; occupation and capture date were not independently verified. A gesture reference; no cowboy hat on the main subject.

references.title: Cowboys Waiting for Roundup · resting poses
references.notes: Catalog date 1907. Visually reviewed: saddled horses, people seated or reclining low in grass, low horizon and open sky. Use for unhurried body positions and space. Smoking is not established.

references.title: Ranching in the Canadian West · camp and clothing
references.notes: Catalog date 1910. Visually reviewed: hats, vests, boots, wagon, tent and varied resting poses. PC009874 is substantially the same scene with a different catalog date. Count as one visual reference. Postcard colors are a palette reference, not verified original scene colors.

references.notes: Ask what the scene needs to accomplish. The purpose here is an unhurried observation; do not introduce an unrelated threat or plot twist.

shots.title: Time to spare
shots.purpose: Place the cowboy in an ordinary, quiet environment and establish his ease.
shots.composition: Wide environmental photograph of one adult cowboy seated loosely in a weathered wooden chair on a modest ranch porch. Full body and boots visible, right elbow on the armrest, cigarette held low in his right hand. Cowboy occupies the right third; shaded doorway behind him and a fence beyond. Room around the subject. Seated eye-level viewpoint.
shots.action: Over five seconds, the seated cowboy makes a small shift in the chair and rests his shoulders. His right hand holds the cigarette low. A thin wisp of smoke drifts upward. Keep gestures small and unhurried.
shots.camera: Fixed eye-level wide shot. Hold the composition throughout.
shots.sound: Soft wind, a faint wooden chair creak and distant birds. Quiet ambience.
shots.continuity: Establish the chair, doorway and fence positions. Right hand holds the cigarette. Preserve this layout in later images.
shots.transition: Cut to a closer view of the same seated posture.

shots.title: A small gesture
shots.purpose: Let an everyday action carry the moment.
shots.composition: Medium three-quarter photograph of the same adult cowboy seated in the same chair, framed from waist upward. His right hand holds a cigarette near chest level, ready to lift it. His eyes look past the camera. Hat brim and shoulders remain clearly readable. Shaded wooden doorway in the background.
shots.action: The cowboy slowly lifts his right hand from chest level, brings the cigarette to his lips, pauses briefly, then lowers his hand toward the armrest. His head remains mostly still. Five seconds, with relaxed pacing.
shots.camera: Fixed seated eye-level medium shot. Preserve screen direction from the preceding wide shot.
shots.sound: Continue the same outdoor ambience. Subtle clothing movement.
shots.continuity: Same face, hat, blue shirt, right hand and cigarette. Chair and lighting match the wide shot. Start from a position physically compatible with the selected preceding take.
shots.transition: Cut after the hand has lowered, leaving space for the exhale.

shots.title: Let it drift
shots.purpose: End on the feeling of having nowhere urgent to be.
shots.composition: Medium-wide photograph of the same cowboy resting in his chair on the ranch porch. Right hand and cigarette lie low near the armrest. His head is turned very slightly toward the open space beside him. Include his knees, chair, shaded doorway and some breathing room beside the figure.
shots.action: The cowboy exhales a thin, irregular stream of smoke, lets his gaze drift slightly farther off-screen, and settles into the chair. His hand stays low. Allow the smoke to disperse naturally over five seconds.
shots.camera: Fixed eye-level medium-wide shot. Hold after the movement settles.
shots.sound: Continuous wind and distant birds. Let the ambience carry the ending.
shots.continuity: Same clothing, face, chair, lighting and right-hand cigarette. Match the preceding take's lowered-hand position before the exhale.
shots.transition: Hold on stillness for the final beat, then end the sequence.
